content:
{
  "root_cause": "The disclosure menu does not close when focus leaves the menu tree via keyboard (Tab), because the root menu lacks a focusout handler to close open submenus when focus moves to an element outside the menu.",
  "repair_strategy": "Add a focusout event listener to the root menu's DOM element that checks if focus has left the menu tree; if so, close all child submenus, reset focus state, and clear the hasOpened flag.",
  "edits": [
    {
      "path": "src/_baseMenu.js",
      "sha256": "659255a214409c4048ca6d6312846a5e9c5c368e5c777b8499f437fdb9418447",
      "before": "/**\\n   * Handles focus events throughout the menu for proper menu use.\\n   *\\n   * - Adds a `focus` listener to every menu item so when it gains focus,\\n   *   it will set the item's containing menu's focus state\\n   *   to \\\"self\\\".\\n   *\\n   * @protected\\n   */\\n  _handleFocus() {\\n    this.elements.menuItems.forEach((menuItem, index) => {\\n      menuItem.dom.link.addEventListener(\\\"focus\\\", () => {\\n        this.focusState = \\\"self\\\";\\n        this.currentChild = index;\\n      });\\n    });\\n  }\\n",
      "after": "/**\\n   * Handles focus events throughout the menu for proper menu use.\\n   *\\n   * - Adds a `focus` listener to every menu item so when it gains focus,\\n   *   it will set the item's containing menu's focus state\\n   *   to \\\"self\\\".\\n   * - For the root menu, adds a `focusout` listener to close open submenus\\n   *   when focus leaves the menu tree.\\n   *\\n   * @protected\\n   */\\n  _handleFocus() {\\n    this.elements.menuItems.forEach((menuItem, index) => {\\n      menuItem.dom.link.addEventListener(\\\"focus\\\", () => {\\n        this.focusState = \\\"self\\\";\\n        this.currentChild = index;\\n      });\\n    });\\n\\n    if (this.isTopLevel) {\\n      // Close the menu when focus leaves the menu tree\\n      this.dom.menu.addEventListener(\\\"focusout\\\", (event) => {\\n        if (!this.dom.menu.contains(event.relatedTarget)) {\\n          this.closeChildren();\\n          this.focusState = \\\"none\\\";\\n          this.hasOpened = false;\\n        }\\n      });\\n    }\\n  }\\n"
    }
  ],
  "expected_accessibility_effect": "When a keyboard user tabs out of the navigation dropdown, the dropdown will close (aria-expanded becomes false, submenu hidden), preventing it from obscuring page content.",
  "functional_risks": [
    "Potential unintended closure if focus moves to an element that is not a DOM descendant of the menu but is logically part of the menu (e.g., a portal).",
    "Edge cases where rapid focus shifts could cause flicker, though the containment check mitigates this."
  ],
  "verification_requirements": [
    "Tabbing from any menu item to an element outside the menu closes the dropdown (aria-expanded false, submenu hidden).",
    "Moving focus within the menu or into a submenu does not close the dropdown.",
    "Keyboard navigation inside the dropdown (arrow keys, Home, End) continues to work when open.",
    "Clicking the Shop button still opens and closes the dropdown as expected.",
    "Mouse hover behavior remains unchanged."
  ]
}
